summary: High-fidelity chromatic shift. An ammonia-free, semi-permanent conditioning color that deposits intense, unadulterated pigment.
description: Aesthetic DNA alteration. This damage-free coloring system acts as a direct dye, coating the outside of the hair shaft in brilliant, fade-resistant color while simultaneously conditioning the strand.
technical_overview: Offered at $22.0 for 150ml, this KoColor HAIR_COLOR is expertly formulated with Water, Cetearyl Alcohol, and Basic Red 51. It delivers a high-fidelity Vivid Crimson color profile (`#DC143C`) and leverages direct-dye deposition optics.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Apply to clean, dry, pre-lightened hair. Process for 30-45 minutes and rinse with cold water.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Mix a spoonful of this color into your daily conditioner to maintain the chromatic intensity between full dye sessions.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Zero ammonia and zero developer mean the structural integrity of the hair's cortex is never compromised during the color shift.
